structuredRefusalContracts: LAUNCH_REFUSED is explicitly recognized and its closed evidence schema, source/run/writer/hash/order, attempt identity and actual typed evidence are independently checked. It is not treated merely as an unknown event.

Actual Popen PID/null, ready byte count/digest, at most two kernel identity reads, UNKNOWN/BOUND consistency, parent identity and any linked registered lease are validated. UNKNOWN birth plus wait0 cleanup remains UNKNOWN birth.

Actual wait source and cleanup status, process-group flag, launch/cleanup clocks and registered-attempt interval are checked; no refused unknown identity creates a successful FINITE_REGISTER or completed task.
The independent replayer returns launchRefusals; verify_lifecycle explicitly rejects qualification after valid refusal evidence. Cleanup success never changes that verdict.

Normal finite registrations require identityWitnessKind PARENT_KERNEL_IDENTITY_WHILE_READY_GATE_HELD; every finite shim SHA must equal the frozen policy source SHA. These are source-bound protocol witnesses, not cryptographic OS attestation.

Any nonempty launchRefusalArtifacts marker is explicitly adverse even without a journal refusal. Invalid marker types also reject. Full packet scanning for unlisted fallback sidecars remains the enclosing archive verifier responsibility.
Full serialized native/API/journal guard replay after a refusal is FAIL with LAUNCH_REFUSED, and independent verification remains adverse.
All preceding native managed-lease, ancestry scope/cutoff, timing, unknown RSS and historical-version boundaries remain intact.
